features.name: Spell-check/text-prediction disabled TextBox and RichEdit
features.description: Scenario 1 shows a TextBox (TextBoxOff) and RichEditBox (RichEditOff) with IsSpellCheckEnabled and IsTextPredictionEnabled = false. Typing produces no red squiggles or suggestions.

expected_behaviour: Two editable fields labelled 'TextBox' and 'RichEdit' appear under the 'IsSpellCheckEnabled and IsTextPredictionEnabled = true' heading
Spell-check underline appears on misspelled words
